recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless the extension definition moves back into core; future wording changes for this artifact should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 Vocabulary issue requesting replacement of the Preliminary-focused comment on the ValueSet workflowStatusDescription extension with broader wording covering workflow or intended-use distinctions when ValueSet.status remains the same.
initial_application: The approved text was applied in core by ade907ca5b1bc08efb093bc524c5b00bdc7fa5ac, which changed source/valueset/structuredefinition-extension-valueset-workflowStatusDescription.xml to the requested broadened comment.
additional_context: The extension definition was later removed from the FHIR core source by dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 as part of the R5 extension-source removal. Current core has no tracked source/valueset workflowStatusDescription StructureDefinition file. The Extension Pack now contains input/definitions/ValueSet/StructureDefinition-valueset-workflowStatusDescription.xml with the approved FHIR-31955 comment, while core ValueSet.status still links to the canonical extension.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core edit was made because the authoritative extension definition is outside this checkout and already contains the approved wording.
